reviews.text: I took it to the valley and I'm super happy with the treatment and humanity. The valley cut is very good.🥰🥰🥰 …
Excellent service, you can tell they care about what they do and it gave me a lot of confidence. They do a spectacular job 💗
It looks really nice
They were so kind and patient with our dogs first groom

It doesn't surprise me that they have the highest rating on Google... They're so nice and super professional.

I took my American Staffordshire Terrier for a manicure/pedicure (😜) and to have his ears cleaned, but I'd love to go back for a full ear cleaning, because they're so lovely and you can tell how much love they put into their work.
I always take my cat Rufino to get his hair removed and they leave him looking super nice.
Thank you so much Isa :)
Thank you so much Irene :-)

Cris is the best in the whole wide world!!!!!! Affectionate, kind, even though Ramón doesn't want to go, hahaha, she's the only one who lets him cut his nails without making a huge mess!!! And when she comes out she smells amazing!!!!❤️❤️❤️❤️ You can really tell that her work and furry friends are her passion.
The best pet groomer in Sant Andreu. They're so gentle with my furry friends; they come out looking gorgeous, happy, and smelling like cotton candy.

We took our Bernese Mountain Dog in and she did a fantastic job!! She did an incredible job and Draco let her do everything, when he won't even let us brush him!! From now on, Draco has a new groomer!! Thank you so much, Elena!!
Very attentive and friendly, they did a good job, maybe a little expensive
Charming with animals, and very friendly with people.
Beautiful haircuts and excellent treatment from Cristina with our pet, whom she has known since she was born.

She's very professional and has a real way with animals. Groomers often have issues with cats, but that wasn't the case here. I always take my cat, who's quite good at letting her groom her, and she does a fantastic job.
The best groomer, without a doubt!! Our dog has known her since he was a puppy and trusts her completely.
Appointments available without weeks of waiting! Great job, my pet is happy!

We went for the first time, on the vet's recommendation, and our dog came out looking gorgeous and, above all, very happy and calm with them. They really inspire confidence. Thank you.

I'm editing my review because I've started taking my dog, who's very wary of the hairdryer. This has meant that at other groomers, the experience hasn't been very good for anyone, but with the girls at Quissos, he came out calm, which is much appreciated. I love the care they give to the animals and how well they do their job.
We came from another neighborhood specifically, we couldn't find a better groomer for our dog. We are delighted.
Cristina not only made my dog ​​look beautiful, but she's also incredibly loving and patient. Poppy is usually scared, but she was delighted with Cristina. Thank you!

They are so kind and know exactly how to deal with cats. I’ve had some horrible experiences in Barcelona with groomers who did not know what they were doing, and were really rough with my cat. Cris and her team are amazing and so good and quickly and effectively grooming my cat with patience and care. She and I both left happy. Highly recommend!

Cristina has a wonderful connection with animals, which, combined with her passion for what she does and the care she puts into it, makes her a gift for dogs, cats, and humans alike. A true professional. Highly recommended.
Thank you very much, Carmen.
Super kind, experienced and professional. Ozzy is in the best hands, Cris and her colleague clearly love and respect their furry clients and give them the best care and treatment.
Cris is a sweetheart...she's very patient and does a fantastic job. My dog ​​isn't easy to handle, but she manages him perfectly. The end result is fantastic. She makes him look gorgeous...
Thank you so much, Yolanda :-)

This is the first time our cat has been to a groomer and we're thrilled. She had so many knots and they did a fantastic job. You can tell they really know how to handle cats; she was so calm when we picked her up.

We are delighted with Cris! Professional, efficient, sweet, and fast! We took Nebeda, our 18-year-old Persian cat, to have her undercoat removed so she wouldn't overheat in the summer, and she has formed a wonderful bond with her. Very attentive and patient. We definitely recommend her 100% and are now regular customers. A 10 out of 10!
The personal attention they give your pet is excellent, and the price is reasonable. Highly recommended.
